story.fullStory:
Creedence Clearwater Revival's "Have You Ever Seen The Rain Hey Tonight" reached #8 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Have You Ever Seen the Rain" is a song by American rock band Creedence Clearwater Revival, written by John Fogerty and released as a single in 29 December 1970 from the album Pendulum (1970).

The song charted highest in Canada, reaching number one on the RPM 100 national singles chart in March 1971.

In the U.S., in the same year it peaked at number eight on the Billboard Hot 100 singles chart.

The song peaked at #8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 10 weeks on the chart.
